html:
Novak Djokovic is a Serbian tennis player, born in Belgrade in 1987, who has won more Grand Slam singles titles than any other man and held the world number one ranking longer than any other player.

He learned the game at a mountain resort in Kopaonik and trained in Belgrade as NATO bombs fell during the Kosovo War in 1999. He broke the long dominance of Roger Federer and Rafael Nadal, winning his first major in 2008 and dozens of titles since, including Olympic gold in 2024. His refusal of the COVID vaccine got him deported from Australia in 2022. In Serbia he is a national hero, and his success gave a country known abroad for its wars a different face.
